Rashi on Gittin 57a:12:1.hebrew: שחליים - מין מאכל הוא, במסכת ע"ז (דף כט.):
Rashi on Gittin 57a:12:1.english: Shaḥalayim [cress] - It is a type of food, [mentioned] in Tractate Avodah Zarah (29a):

Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:1.english: That place - Har HaMelekh [the King's Mountain]:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:2.hebrew: משקריתו - דאמריתו ששים רבוא עיירות היו בהר המלך, והוא אינו מחזיק אפילו ששים רבוא קנים:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:2.english: You lie - for you say [that] six hundred thousand cities were in Har HaMelekh [the King's Mountain], yet it does not hold even six hundred thousand reeds:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:3.hebrew: גמדא - דטריו"ש בלע"ז, כמו "גמוד מסאני" (פסחים דף קיא.):
Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:3.english: It contracts [gamda] - Detrois in Old French [meaning contracted or narrowed], like [the phrase] "gamud mesanei" [the shoes shrank] (Pesachim 111a):

Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:4.hebrew: אין עורו מחזיק בשרו - משהופשט הוא כווץ, ואין יכול לחזור ולכסותו בו:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:13:4.english: Its hide does not hold its flesh - Once it has been flayed, it shrinks, and one cannot cover [the flesh] with it again.

Rashi on Gittin 57a:14:1.hebrew: דשמיע ליה - מה מעשיהם, אם צדיקים אם רשעים:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:14:1.english: Who has heard - [meaning,] what their deeds are, whether [they are] righteous or wicked:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:15:1.english: Involving a betrothed man and his betrothed [woman] - From that same city:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:16:1.hebrew: שפטפט - זלזל ביצרו ולא חשבו, אלא נתגבר עליו:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:16:1.english: Who conquered [shepitpet] - He belittled his [evil] inclination and gave it no regard, rather he overcame it.

Rashi on Gittin 57a:17:1.english: And the rate decreased - the grain became more expensive:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:18:1.hebrew: לובן ביצה - שהוא דומה לשכבת זרע, להוציא קול שבאו על אשתו:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:18:1.english: The white of an egg - for it resembles semen, [in order] to spread a rumor that they had relations with his wife:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:19:1.english: Contracts - [In Old French,] detreit, [meaning] it dries up and congeals:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:19:2.hebrew: שכבת זרע דוחה מן האור - נכנס ונבלע בבגד, ואינו מגליד:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:19:2.english: Semen is repelled from the fire - [it] enters and is absorbed into the garment, and does not congeal:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:1:1.english: With that which he decreed upon himself - [namely,] being burned and having [his] ashes scattered:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:22:1.hebrew: קרני מלחמה - ראשי גייסות תוקעי קרן, ומתאספים עליהם בני צבאם:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:22:1.english: Battle horns - Troop commanders who blow a horn, and their soldiers gather around them:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:22:2.english: And lest you say [that the city] was close - to the sea:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:23:1.english: The Yadayim Valley - [This is] the name of a place:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:23:2.english: And one [part] blood - from those slain at Beitar:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:2:1.hebrew: בשכבת זרע רותחת - מדה כנגד מדה, שבעצתו התחיל העם לזנות אל בנות מואב:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:2:1.english: In boiling semen - [This is] measure for measure, for through his counsel the people began to engage in licentiousness with the daughters of Moab.

Rashi on Gittin 57a:4:1.hebrew: דאמר מר - בעירובין (דף כא:), ויליף לה מ"ולהג הרבה יגיעת בשר" — המלעיג הרבה נידון ביגיעת בשר. וקרא בדברי סופרים כתיב: "ויותר מהמה בני הזהר" — בדברי סופרים יותר מדברי תורה:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:4:1.english: As the Master said - [This is] in Eruvin (21b), and [the Gemara] derives it from [the verse], "And much study [lahag] is a weariness of the flesh" [Ecclesiastes 12:12] — one who mocks [mal'ig] much is punished with weariness of the flesh. And the verse is written regarding the words of the Scribes: "And furthermore, my son, be admonished" — [be more careful] with the words of the Scribes than with the words of the Torah:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:4:2.hebrew: נביאי האומות עובדי ע"ז - בלעם, שהשכינה נגלית עליו והרשיע לדבר:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:4:2.english: The prophets of the idol-worshipping nations - [This refers to] Balaam, to whom the Divine Presence was revealed, yet he acted wickedly in speaking [against Israel]:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:6:1.english: Tur Malka - A region whose name is Har HaMelech [the King's Mountain]:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:7:1.hebrew: נפלו - בני המדינה היהודים עלייהו דרומאי, ומחונהו:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:7:1.english: They fell - the Jewish residents of the city [fell] upon them, the Romans, and beat them:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:7:3.english: There was among them - among the Jews:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:9:2.english: Until [it] was visible - to the soldiers:

Rashi on Gittin 57a:9:3.hebrew: בליונא דגושפנקא - מי שהיתה לו צורה בטבעתו, היה מכירה רחוק מיל מן העיר למראה הנרות:
Rashi on Gittin 57a:9:3.english: The image on a seal [bilyona degushpanka] - Whoever had an image on his ring could recognize it [at a distance of] a mil from the city by the light of the candles:
